evidence: After growth, high-resolution X-ray diffraction (HRXD) measurement using Cu Ks radiation was carried out around the (004) reflection to determine the SL period from the spacing of satellites. The surface of the epilayers was mirror like and showed the same flatness as the GaAs substrate, shown by Nomarski interference contrast micrographs. The full width at half-maximum (FWHM) of the diffraction peaks is approximately 800 arcsec. The spectrum of the superlattice with a period length of 6MLZnTe/6MLCdTe clearly shows satellites up to the order of + 2 and -2. The position of the zero-order peak of asymmetric reflections is determined by the average composition x of the SL and the strain within the layers.
